Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length Two Wide , Drifted Back to 2.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up and only Held Ground in Straight # no real excuses

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well rail went Through to lead marginally (800m), joined 600, headed off into the Straight trying to rally, whip 250 holding Ground before fading latter stages # led the winner

Jumped best & Went Forward to lead by nearly 2 Lengths on fence, Held Together in front & led 1.5 Lengths turning, steered just short of centre of track Straightening Up , started to draw further away early in straight, got wider as it went further away down the running # led/dominat win
Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn under pressure. weakened. run queried # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re performance, rdr std his mnt travelled comfortably outside the leader in early and middle stages, however when race tempo increased leaving the 600m, it was under full pressure shortly after and failed to sprint strongly from this point and weakened over the final 200m. Tnr explained the mare was having its first start for his stable and he had expected a forward showing, and he could offer no genuine excuse for the performance. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Tnr subsequently reported results of a blood test revealed the mare to be dehydrated.
